Diagnostic timings include ordinary host activity and some concurrent focused tests; not isolated throughput or stable latency benchmarks. SQL result hashes compared wherever pre-fix query completed. Before-phase timed-out queries have no result comparison; independent HTTP manifest oracle is a separate acceptance gate.
